children: Media measurement firm's Q3 revenue fell yr/yr, reflecting Movies business divestiture
Adjusted EBITDA for Q3 declined from prior year
Company posted net loss on goodwill impairment and restructuring costs
Comscore reaffirms 2026 revenue outlook of $315 mln to $325 mln
Company expects 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin in the low-to-mid single digits
Comscore targets $20 mln to $25 mln in annual run-rate cost savings from realignment plan
MOVIES BUSINESS DIVESTITURE - Revenue fell due to the sale of the Movies business in May 2026, which removed $9.5 mln in revenue versus the prior year
LOWER SYNDICATED DIGITAL PRODUCT PERFORMANCE - Company said weaker performance in syndicated digital products contributed to revenue decline
LOWER CUSTOM PRODUCT RENEWALS - Research & Insight Solutions revenue declined due to fewer renewals and reduced deliveries of certain custom digital products
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the advertising & marketing peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Comscore Inc is $5.00, about 47.9% above its November 2 closing price of $3.38
